rationale: This is clearly an auto collision claim: motor vehicle rear-ended at a red light causing total vehicle loss and injuries to the policyholder.
claim_summary: Policyholder Pat Morgan (POL-1003) was rear-ended at red light on Route 9 yesterday at 8:15 AM by vehicle traveling ~35 mph; sustained total vehicle loss (trunk crushed into back seat) and injuries (whiplash, sprained wrist). Police report with other driver's insurance information available. High-severity claim requiring vehicle inspection and injury documentation coordination.

case_facts.description: Rear-end collision; other vehicle traveling ~35 mph without braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: Total loss; entire trunk crushed into back seat
